about: CHAT_PLAN decision 65 (INBOX 808, 810): a question about what Atlas can do is answered about Atlas, never searched. 'asks' are the phrasings that must be read as capability questions (40, the owner's own first: 'can you search the web?'); 'requests' name what to do and must not be.
asks: could you look things up online?
are you able to browse websites?
is it possible to search the web?
are you able to remind me of things?
can you count days until a date?
can you read text in images?
what can I do in this app
requests: can you search the web for gaming mice
can you remind me to call mum tomorrow
can you find my note about the passport
can you summarise my gym notes
can you translate this note into French
what is there about a gaming mouse?
what's the time in western australia
search the web for lisbon hotels
can you tag the gym note strength
what have I saved about courses & study?
could you tell me about my uni notes
can you open settings and turn on dark mode for me please now
is it possible that I left my keys at work
